newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European fuel oil bunkers steady, buyers cautious.
newsitem.headline: European fuel oil bunkers steady, buyers cautious.

text.p: European fuel oil bunker prices were steady on Tuesday with buyers mostly awaiting further developments this week, dealers said.
Rotterdam bunkers were still traded at around $85/$87 fob as barges were stuck in Monday's trading range.
Total ARA volume was around 10,000 tonnes, most of it fixed in the morning.
Hamburg bunkers were similarly steady and subdued.
Mediterranean fuel oil was steady to soft, while gas oil rose in most ports.
Many suppliers said many shipowners appeared willing to delay their purchases.
